title: helichrysum asperum var. albidulum
intro: Helichrysum asperum var. albidulum, commonly known as Silver Ghost or White Ghost, is a plant species within the daisy family, Asteraceae, characterized by its white or pale yellow flowers and silvery-gray foliage. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum asperum var. albidulum are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which have been shown to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include compounds such as 1,8-cineole, borneol, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
